note: block 2 of 2: eight switches on medium land maps, long games, 24 per config: S = two scouts; E = campaign from twice the strongest enemy hero seen; C = supply runs; T = buildings and creature banks valued by their table (the standard since 17.11. - off means tables 0); P = the way out of the home region (passage: a guard in a gap counts with the region behind it, with regionValue 8000, troops fetched by their share, land behind a guard counted from the guard, main hero looks 12 days ahead); W = simulated fights against map guards (fightForecast); A = troops judged by what they do to the army, buildings with rules of their own, the fastest creature stays with a hero that hands over its army (armyFit, sites, fastKeeper); H = battle knowledge: what attacks do beyond their damage (death stare, petrifying, ageing ...) and spells cast by how the fight ends (simAfterHit, spellSearch 2). Design 2^(8-4), resolution IV: P = E*C*T, W = S*C*T, A = S*E*C, H = S*E*T; two blocks by S*E. Evaluate both blocks together with arena/effects.py. Why: in logged games of the standard the main hero never leaves its corner of the map (24 centaur captains unbeaten for 93 days, army 443,000, 20 % explored, lost); the first half of the seven-switch test showed S, C and E each a little ahead and magicFocus clearly behind; banks gained +0.157 +- 0.125 on the set with all factions.
